limits.text: No PDF/UA check was run on the review PDF.
One contribution per journey was made with the keyboard only at 390 px. No other keyboard-only or screen-reader pass was made.
No planner reviewed whether the review files or the response are useful. Agent-run checks are the acceptance evidence.
The comments were entered by an automated proof run and represent no one. A few test comments are not public opinion.
The published response was written by an automated proof run under a demonstration label and speaks for no agency.
No AI feature ran: translation, AI moderation, AI synthesis and AI drafting are out of scope.

The journey read these on live screens and the checker cannot read them again: the public response page's counts and its search for the rejected comment, the public portal data searched for staff-only fields, the statuses an anonymous participant and a second account received, the accessibility results, console errors and sideways scroll of each screen, and the closed campaign's public addresses.

Which build ran comes from the health readbacks the journey wrote at its start and end. The record's origin and each journey's mode are also the journey's own statements, carried from its run files. Nothing in the record comes from the deployment itself.

Which contribution was made with the keyboard only, and at which width, is the journey's statement. The record holds no keyboard trail, and the page counted no pointer events. Whether each contribution has a map point is checked against the internal review workbook.
The AI flags, the staff review's approval and its revision number are set by the journey after the app accepted each step. The journey presses no AI control; the checker cannot see that.

After each journey the lead looked at the journey's own anonymous screenshots of the closed portal and about page. The run files hide the campaign's public address, so the lead did not load it in a separate session.

The invitation's sentence that the only review of comments is by the same automated run was added after the last local dress rehearsal. It first ran on the hosted site, where the journey checked it on the portal and on page 1 of both review files.
Every time in the review files is printed in UTC, not in the place's local time.
No response was emailed to subscribers, and no participant subscribed. Only account confirmation email was used.
